IPT.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/11] The treatment condition in our study was cognitive bibliotherapy for depression. The book used was Feeling Good (Burns, 1980), which has a theoretical foundation derived from Beck's (1970) cognitive theory of depression.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/1/Text/9] Potential participants were assessed for eligibility through an initial telephone call. Appropriate participants were then invited for a screening interview and initial assessment. The initial assessment phase consisted of administration of the PIAT-R Reading Comprehension Test, the CDI, the ATQ, the DAS, the CBT, the CBCL, and the HRSD. [/page/1/Text/10] Following this initial assessment, participants meeting inclusion criteria were assigned on a random basis to either the immediate-treatment condition or the delayed-treatment condition.
